- Steven also has a directed path to Carol:  
  Steven \(\to\) Shirley \(\to\) David \(\to\) Noah \(\to\) Denise \(\to\) Anthony \(\to\) Mark \(\to\) Madison \(\to\) Deborah \(\to\) Judith \(\to\) Jerry \(\to\) George \(\to\) Julie \(\to\) Theresa \(\to\) Elijah \(\to\) Linda \(\to\) Thomas \(\to\) Kathleen \(\to\) Henry \(\to\) Bryan \(\to\) Jack \(\to\) Zachary \(\to\) Ralph \(\to\) Catherine \(\to\) Hannah \(\to\) Jordan \(\to\) Philip \(\to\) William \(\to\) Grace \(\to\) Doris \(\to\) Timothy \(\to\) Jason \(\to\) Mason \(\to\) Carolyn \(\to\) Isabella \(\to\) Brenda \(\to\) Danielle \(\to\) Joshua \(\to\) Alexander \(\to\) Diane \(\to\) Laura \(\to\) Patrick \(\to\) Kyle \(\to\) Marie \(\to\) Joseph \(\to\) Tyler \(\to\) Kelly \(\to\) Nancy \(\to\) Justin \(\to\) Amber \(\to\) Karen \(\to\) Jeffrey \(\to\) Olivia \(\to\) Alice \(\to\) Samantha \(\to\) Amy \(\to\) Brittany \(\to\) Gerald \(\to\) Lawrence \(\to\) Gary \(\to\) Charlotte \(\to\) Kenneth \(\to\) Jean \(\to\) Stephen \(\to\) Amanda \(\to\) Mary \(\to\) Megan \(\to\) Gabriel \(\to\) Willie \(\to\) Emily \(\to\) Lisa \(\to\) Eric \(\to\) Jonathan \(\to\) Wayne \(\to\) Sophia \(\to\) Helen \(\to\) Sandra \(\to\) Bruce \(\to\) Melissa \(\to\) Emma \(\to\) Victoria \(\to\) Christopher \(\to\) Richard \(\to\) Michelle \(\to\) James \(\to\) Randy \(\to\) Samuel \(\to\) Nicole \(\to\) Katherine \(\to\) Roy \(\to\) Judy \(\to\) Janice \(\to\) Julia \(\to\) Austin \(\to\) Cheryl \(\to\) Evelyn \(\to\) Jessica \(\to\) Donald \(\to\) Ann \(\to\) Teresa \(\to\) Matthew \(\to\) Betty \(\to\) Kevin \(\to\) Kimberly \(\to\) Joe \(\to\) Adam \(\to\) Jeremy \(\to\) Marilyn \(\to\) Terry \(\to\) Frances \(\to\) Donna \(\to\) Juan \(\to\) Nathan \(\to\) Angela \(\to\) Debra \(\to\) Vincent \(\to\) Jesse \(\to\) Carol.

Thus Steven is a common ancestor of both Rebecca and Carol, which matches option 4. No directed path exists from Rebecca to Carol (Rebecca has out-degree 0) or from Carol to Rebecca (Carol has out-degree 0), eliminating options 1 and 3. Neither individual has any descendants, eliminating option 2.
